messages:
rajesh_cs: Heads-up team — Northvale Health dropped a vendor risk form asking for: exact SOC2 scope statement, DPA language on request log retention, and proof of BYOK key provenance. They've marked this as a renewal risk if we can't produce evidence within 5 business days. Need security/legal + onboarding input. :urgent:

emma_onboard: Thanks Rajesh. I asked them to list which fields in the form are mandatory vs optional. They replied they want an "evidence package" (screenshots + exports) and contract language only if the evidence isn't enough.

dylan_infosec: Quick answers: SOC2 in-scope = hosted prod API and control plane; Dedicated clusters have separate attestations we reference. Retention defaults: request logs 90 days, billing events 12 months, embeddings cache 30 days by default. For BYOK provenance we can produce a sanitized audit export with key creation metadata, IAM principal, and rotation records.

nora_legal: If they want DPA clause text we use the standard retention schedule + an addendum template for bespoke retention. For key provenance we provide an exhibit that lists acceptable evidence (KMS audit export, key policy snapshot, certificate chain when HSM used). Confirm if Northvale wants contract edits or just the exhibit.

max_engineering: To extract the KMS provenance we have a tool. Example run for a customer:
```bash
# run from infra/tools
python tools/export_key_provenance.py --customer northvale --start 2024-06-01 --end 2025-06-01 
# produces northvale_key_provenance_20250601.json (PII sanitized)
```
We can scrub principals and replace with role labels before sharing.

infra-bot: infra-bot uploaded a file: //drive.redwood/northvale/onboarding/evidence/northvale_key_provenance_20250601.json

rajesh_cs: Nice. Can security/legal produce a short one-pager (SOC2 scope blurb, retention table, list of evidence artifacts + example sanitized snippet) that I can send to the customer first? Trying to minimize legal churn.

dylan_infosec: I'll draft the one-pager. Outline: 1) SOC2 scope sentence, 2) retention table (requests/billing/embeddings/caches), 3) BYOK evidence types and a 3-line sanitized sample from the export.

nora_legal: I'll draft the DPA exhibit language for retention and key-provenance, plus a suggested signature clause if they insist on contract text.

emma_onboard: Timeline: draft one-pager by tomorrow 10am PT, legal to review by EOD, send to Northvale by Wednesday. If they confirm evidence is sufficient we avoid escalation.

max_engineering: One more note: hosted currently supports cloud KMS providers (AWS/GCP/Azure). HSM-backed BYOK for hosted mode is not available yet; we should mark this as a product request if they require HSM attestation.

rajesh_cs: Good call. Please flag product. I'll update Northvale on timeline and post back here if they ask for contract edits. Thanks all :thumbsup:
